findings.detail: firstWindow can retain the completed about:blank load state; the real preload exposes the bridge before the initial bundled DOMContentLoaded. The next DOM event may therefore be the initial document, while the public session can resolve before the later authentication-return loadURL.

All six bundled setup observations were still installing at the service step and every app close cancelled that installer. Those samples did not establish an installed-app baseline. The original slower median remains a failed result.

change.navigation: Wait for the actual bundled root URL and its DOMContentLoaded before arming the authentication-return event; preserve ordinary PKCE, IPC session checks and navigation failures.
change.diagnostics: Bounded main-document event classes, lifecycle phases and owned source positions only; no raw URLs, exception messages, identities or credentials.
change.preparation: One owned userData profile with the existing separate hosted and bundled partitions. Both modes must pass the existing real registered-device/signed-in/server-online gate before cold samples.
unchanged: usable-chat stopwatch and strict bundled-faster threshold
ordinary hosted cookies and native PKCE
per-sample installer cancellation, app close and exact-profile daemon drain

limits: The controlled navigation probe is not provider OAuth acceptance.
The precise destroyed evaluation in the original CI log is not identified.
The old cold median is not replaced by a corrected preparation method or by source tests.
The one-hour idle run did not execute in the original failed lifecycle.
